[ 04 / How it works ]

No hourly meter. No surprises.

  1. Clarify

    We learn your business, your customers and the one thing you want visitors to do next.

  2. Create

    We shape the message, design the pages and build the working website. You approve what goes live.

  3. Deliver

    We test, refine and hand off something dependable. Most builds take about a week once content is in.

[ 05 / Questions from Bowling Green ]

Before you call.

Do you work with businesses that serve BGSU students?

Yes. J&T Auto Service has a page written just for students, covering what to do when you’re new in town and the car starts making a noise. We think about who’s new and what they don’t know yet.

Do you meet in Bowling Green?

Yes. We’ve already built for a Bowling Green business, and it’s under an hour from the studio in Tiffin.

What does a website cost?

Most small-business websites start at $1,200. After a short call we send a fixed quote in writing, so you know the cost, scope and timing before any paid work starts. No hourly meter.
